title: Overmode
summary: Overmode is a modified version of Strikemode created by Klaus. Through firing a reddish, goo-like energy, the targeted Seeker is transformed into a larger, more powerful creature.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Overmode was developed as one of [[Klaus]]' many laboratory experiments and was based on the [[Strikemode]] spell. This spell later was used by Klaus on his [[Suits]] to turn them into strong, monstrous forms. {{source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}}

Klaus' [[Suits]] appeared to have returned to normal by the time the Huntik team attacked [[Organization Central]]. It is unknown if the effects had worn off naturally or if magic was required for their recovery. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}}

full_text:
Overmode is a modified version of Strikemode created by Klaus. Through firing a reddish, goo-like energy, the targeted Seeker is transformed into a larger, more powerful creature.

History

Overmode was developed as one of Klaus' many laboratory experiments and was based on the Strikemode spell. This spell later was used by Klaus on his Suits to turn them into strong, monstrous forms. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Klaus' Suits appeared to have returned to normal by the time the Huntik team attacked Organization Central. It is unknown if the effects had worn off naturally or if magic was required for their recovery. [Doorway to Huntik]

Trivia

• In the TCG, Overmode appears under the card name "Unnatural Enhancement".
